Software Engineer, Network OS — Arista Networks

Location: Santa Clara, CA
Seniority: 2-5 years

About the role:
Build and maintain software for high-scale network operating systems. Work spans
control-plane services, switch software, and security-sensitive networking features
used by large enterprise and cloud customers.

Requirements:
- C/C++ or Go experience in systems/networking contexts
- Solid understanding of routing, switching, or network protocols
- Experience debugging multi-process systems on Linux
- Comfort with security considerations in networking software

Preferred:
- Prior internship or industry experience in networking vendors
- Familiarity with BGP, EVPN, or similar protocols
- Knowledge of FIPS / Common Criteria style compliance work is a plus

Domain: networking, security, systems
